blocks.content: There are two steps involved in creating objects:
To solve the problem mentioned on the last page, we will first create a class named Student.
This Student class has two variables name and score, and a method checkPassFail().

Think of a class as a blueprint of a house. It contains all the details about the floors, doors, windows, etc. Based on these descriptions, we build the house. The actual physical house is the object.
Now, let's see the part for creating objects.
Once we define a class, we can create as many objects as we want from the class.

blocks.alt: Creating objects from classes in Java

blocks.content: In the image, we have created objects student1 and student2 from the Student class.
All the objects of this Student class will have their own name and score variables and can use the checkPassFail() method.
